bio:
I'm a student developer at **Vanderbilt University** who likes turning fuzzy ideas into polished, working software. I build end to end, from React interfaces to Node and Python back ends, and I'm especially interested in practical AI: products where a model quietly makes the experience better.

I work spec-first. I write down what a feature must do and why before writing code, which keeps projects focused and easy to extend.
